items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: He's auditioning for a rock band all the time... He stopped playing my music a long time ago. ... that little kid that played with Miles Davis.

ctx.x: He used to be, but in the last five years, I wouldn't say that. He's auditioning for a rock band all the time. Hoping some rock players will hear him. He stopped playing my music a long time ago. He was still playing the basic part of it, but his choice of cymbals and his beat is rock. (Inaudible) or that little kid that played with Miles Davis.
